name: qa_wide
title: OS-INSFX-FX2 X1, the Wide effect module (modules/effects/wide, kind 2, ABI 1.12, a WIDENS stereo effect) as a track insert from the console: loaded from the card, bound with `diag ins`, heard on headphones, its tail ends at once, and its cost read with `diag bench insert` (bench image). Needs an image with OS-INSFX-ABI2 A4 (the stereo track adapter): before it the OS never calls render_st and the insert is silent. Console only: the insert is NOT saved (S3), and the console has no insert parameter verb, so the Width, Time and Low cut sweeps and the four factory presets (`ins preset` when the console has it, else the INSERTS page) are a hand check. Needs modules/effects/wide.tmod on the card (the build's modules/wide.tmod, copied by the tester). Reset the unit first so that wide is the only effect module loaded (`diag bench insert` times the first loaded effect). Writes nothing to the card. Leaves no insert bound

steps.say: OS-INSFX-FX2 X1, rows QA-GLB-210, 211, 212 and 213 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with; QA-GLB-211 and 212 are host tests). Put modules/effects/wide.tmod on the card, reset the unit so that no other effect module is loaded, and open a project with a MONO sample sounding on track 1 (the Dense8 song of OS-DENSE has one, or any project whose track 1 plays a mono sample). Use headphones. The insert is console-bound: it is lost on save and on reload until the project record lands (slice S3). The default setting is Width 50 %, Time 12 ms, Low cut 200 Hz: track 1 must sound wider, with the bass and the centre where they were, and its MONO SUM must be the same as bypassed (`ins bypass 1 1 on` and `off` to compare; a USB recording of MAIN summed to mono keeps the dry level)

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
QA-GLB-210: the packed module passes the loader on the unit

QA-GLB-210: loaded, version 1.0.0; `mod` also says where its hot part runs (the SRAM_L slab or SDRAM): read it against the hot size of the build (the CI build's o3m_pack line, at most 1.5 KB) and where its 8 KB state is (SDRAM)
QA-GLB-210: bound to track 1, slot 1, with its default parameters; the OS runs it through the stereo adapter (a WIDENS effect)

QA-GLB-210: the insert runs (wet on) and its measured cycles and share of the block are on the line (the spec's budget for a WIDENS insert is 4 points with the adapter [Q4]; the estimate is about 3.1 % [est]); its 8 KB state is over the 4 KiB arena, so it is in SDRAM (`mod` says where)
QA-GLB-210: the load with the insert on; underruns 0; read it against the same project with no insert
QA-GLB-210: nothing was forced to dry

steps.say: QA-GLB-210, by ear on headphones: a mono sample on track 1 has a stereo image (the defaults: a gentle widening, a soft comb in the highs; no zipper or click) with the bass and the centre in the middle, and is NOT louder than bypassed (compare with `ins bypass 1 1 on`); the other tracks are unchanged. Then `ins bypass 1 1 on`: the narrow sound returns with no click. QA-GLB-212 on the unit: record MAIN over USB with the insert on, sum it to mono and compare the level with the bypassed run: the same (the mono sum cancels the effect)

steps.note: QA-GLB-210: bypass is the host's one-block ramp to dry
QA-GLB-210: off resets the module (shutdown, init) and the effect starts from an empty line: no thump
QA-GLB-210: a second and a half after the stop there is no `tail` word: the module returns 0 once the 30 ms line is dry and the high-pass has rung out (about 45 ms at the defaults)
QA-GLB-210: the render figure is a stopped transport's, with the effect bound and idle

expect: BENCH insert_st \d+ 64 avg \d+ max \d+ \(Wide, adapter \d+ cycles \(\d+\.\d%\) peak \d+\)
steps.note: QA-GLB-213: bench image (`-DO3OS_BENCH=ON`, with the stereo adapter of OS-INSFX-ABI2 A4), transport stopped, wide the only loaded effect: `insert_st_effect` is render_st() of 64 frames alone at the defaults (the estimate is about 3.2k cycles), `insert_st` the whole stereo insert with the adapter (about 8.2k [est]); the adapter is `insert_st` minus `insert_st_effect`. Quote min, avg and max in cycles and as a share of the 261,225-cycle block against the budget (4 points = 10.4k cycles, the adapter included: docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX2 WIDE rows)

steps.say: QA-GLB-213: copy the BENCH lines (min / avg / max) into docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX2 WIDE rows, and into the module's README; over the 4-point budget the slice stops for the maintainer (spec Q4, R1)
